# clickup_filtered_team_tasks (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Workspace ID

### Optional

- `assignees` (List of String) Filter by Assignees using people's ClickUp user id. For example: \
 \
`?assignees[]=1234&assignees[]=5678`
- `custom_fields` (List of String) Include tasks with specific values in one or more Custom Fields. Custom Relationships are included.\
 \
For example: `?custom_fields=[{"field_id":"abcdefghi12345678","operator":"=","value":"1234"}{"field_id":"jklmnop123456","operator":"<","value":"5"}]`\
 \
Only set Custom Field values display in the `value` property of the `custom_fields` parameter. The `=` operator isn't supported with Label Custom Fields.\
 \
Learn more about [filtering using Custom Fields.](doc:taskfilters)
- `custom_items` (List of Number) Filter by custom task types. For example: \
 \
`?custom_items[]=0&custom_items[]=1300` \
 \
Including `0` returns tasks. Including `1` returns Milestones. Including any other number returns the custom task type as defined in your Workspace.
- `date_created_gt` (Number) Filter by date created greater than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `date_created_lt` (Number) Filter by date created less than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `date_done_gt` (Number) Filter by date done greater than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `date_done_lt` (Number) Filter by date done less than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `date_updated_gt` (Number) Filter by date updated greater than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `date_updated_lt` (Number) Filter by date updated less than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `due_date_gt` (Number) Filter by due date greater than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `due_date_lt` (Number) Filter by due date less than Unix time in milliseconds.
- `include_closed` (Boolean) Include or excluse closed tasks. By default, they are excluded.\
 \
To include closed tasks, use `include_closed: true`.
- `include_markdown_description` (Boolean) To return task descriptions in Markdown format, use `?include_markdown_description=true`.
- `list_ids` (List of String) Filter by Lists. For example: \
 \
`?list_ids[]=1234&list_ids[]=6789`
- `order_by` (String) Order by a particular field. By default, tasks are ordered by `created`.\
 \
Options include: `id`, `created`, `updated`, and `due_date`.
- `page` (Number) Page to fetch (starts at 0).
- `parent` (String) Include the parent task ID to return subtasks.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Filter by Folders. For example: \
 \
`?project_ids[]=1234&project_ids[]=6789`
- `reverse` (Boolean) Tasks are displayed in reverse order.
- `space_ids` (List of String) Filter by Spaces. For example: \
 \
`?space_ids[]=1234&space_ids[]=6789`
- `statuses` (List of String) Filter by statuses. Use `%20` to represent a space character. To include closed tasks, use the `include_closed` parameter. \
 \
For example: \
 \
`?statuses[]=to%20do&statuses[]=in%20progress`
- `subtasks` (Boolean) Include or exclude subtasks. By default, subtasks are excluded.
- `tags` (List of String) Filter by tags. User `%20` to represent a space character. For example: \
 \
`?tags[]=tag1&tags[]=this%20tag`

### Read-Only

- `tasks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
